description: courtscheduler refused the booking or the call to it failed (LPT-2590). Shaped like public.hearing.manage-results-failed. 'type' says how a consumer should react: BUSINESS is a deliberate refusal, shown to the clerk by 'code'; TECHNICAL goes to the standard technical error page. 'reason' is courtscheduler's own text plus the HTTP status, for logs only - not user-facing and not translated. 'bookingId' is present only when the request carried one: a refused first pick has none. It is a plain string, not a uuid, so that an unexpected id can never make the framework drop this event for failing its schema. Adding a code is a public-contract change and must match ProvisionalBookingFailureCode.
